verdict.rationale: x402 documents agent-initiated stablecoin payments end to end. Agents pay in USDC from agentic accounts, and the CDP Facilitator validates each payment and submits settlement onchain. The supported rails are listed explicitly: ERC-20 tokens on EVM networks such as Base, Polygon and Arbitrum, and SPL tokens on Solana, across the exact, upto and batch-settlement schemes. Community reports and a runtime probe of live USDC/Base listings corroborate this. Missing for 10: hands-on verification of an actual onchain settlement (the facilitator endpoint is auth-gated, so the probe could not exercise settlement directly).

support.subject: As a developer, I can settle agent-initiated payments in stablecoins over documented rails

citations.quote: it validates signed payments, screens transactions, submits settlement onchain, and reports the result to your resource server
